name: hoods
description: Road bike, hands on the hoods. Torso 45 deg from horizontal; left crank at the top of the stroke (most closed hip), right near the bottom.
provenance: Fit-engine-poc 2.2, 2026-10-14. Angles from typical road bike-fit ranges, tuned so that on the Anny template the hip-joint-to-shoulder-joint line and the joint angles come out as: torso 45 deg from horizontal, closed hip angle 60 deg at the top of the stroke; measured angles per body are in engine/docs/anny-spike/metrics.md. To be checked against photos of team members on a trainer.
convention: Anny local-ref pose parameterization. Each rotation is [rx, ry, rz] in degrees about axes aligned with the world in the rest pose, applied as Rz*Ry*Rx relative to the parent bone. World axes: +X body's left, -Y forward, +Z up. Positive rx tips a bone forward. Rotating root tilts the whole body about the pelvis.
